npcs.name: Agavar
profile: I own all of these fields... but I am too old to plow them now. If you'd plow them for me, and plant seeds, all of the produce can be yours, if you take it.

npcs.name: Andero
profile: Wow you look like a good artist! Here, buy a canvas or a camera and film and let me see your work.

profile: Click on the buy and sell buttons below to buy and sell items. Highlight the item select the amount then press OK.

Fire does not effect us in the slightest.
